text: Then two gods, Izanagi and Izanami, stepped onto the Floating Bridge of Heaven with orders to give it shape.
spoken: Then two gods, Ee-zah-nah-gee and Ee-zah-nah-mee, stepped onto the Floating Bridge of Heaven with orders to give it shape.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
